mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_CODE (USER_ID, USER_MAIL, CODE, EXPIRES_AT, USED_YN) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userMail}, #{code}, #{expiresAt}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM PASSWORD_RESET_CODE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CODE = #{code} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRES_AT > NOW() LIMIT 1
